# AUTO-APPLIED PRODUCTION-GRADE ENGINEERING STANDARDS

You apply these to EVERY build WITHOUT being asked. INFER which standards each feature triggers and apply them silently — do not ask permission, do not list them back. A list/feed/table → pagination + virtualization + caching. An endpoint → authz + validation + rate limit. An external call → timeout + retry + idempotency. A screen → loading/empty/error states. Bake each as a CI gate / pre-commit hook / IaC policy / scaffold default so it is enforced by machines, not memory — and impossible to ship without. This is the FAANG/unicorn bar: build it right the first time so it never has to be rewritten or firefought.

## ARCHITECTURE & SCALE
- **Stateless services.** No in-process session/file state; externalize to Redis/DB/S3. Treat every instance as disposable (cattle, not pets); 12-factor config via env vars; ≥2 replicas always, never single-instance prod.
- **Horizontal-first + autoscale on the right signal.** Containerize; HPA/KEDA on CPU AND custom metrics (queue depth, p95, RPS); sane min/max replicas; scale-down stabilization to stop flapping; hard ceilings on every autoscaler (runaway-bill guard).
- **Graceful lifecycle.** Separate liveness/readiness/startup probes; SIGTERM drains in-flight work, fails readiness, closes connections; `preStop` sleep so the LB deregisters first; grace period > longest request. Zero dropped requests per deploy.
- **Spread + isolate.** PodDisruptionBudgets, anti-affinity / topology spread, ≥2 AZs; bulkhead resource pools per dependency.
- **L7 load balancing.** Health checks + passive outlier ejection; least-request/EWMA over round-robin; connection draining tied to readiness.
- **Pagination — EVERY list/feed/table.** Keyset/cursor on an indexed `(sort_col, id)`, never `OFFSET`; opaque cursor + `nextCursor`; hard-cap page size server-side (clamp `limit`, e.g. ≤100); require pagination on all collection endpoints by contract.
- **Async-offload slow/non-critical work.** Emails, thumbnails, webhooks, exports → durable queue + workers; request just enqueues and returns. DLQ for poison messages, max-retry policy, alert on DLQ depth, replay tooling. Outbox pattern (event in the same DB txn + relay/CDC) for DB↔event consistency. Scheduled jobs use leader election / distributed lock so N replicas don't double-fire; jitter start times.
- **Stable contracts.** Versioned API (`/v1`); additive-only changes within a version; deprecation + sunset window; schema-first (OpenAPI/protobuf) with contract tests in CI; tolerant readers, reserved field numbers, never renumber.
- **Right-grained transactions.** Short txns, Read Committed default (Serializable only where needed); NO external/HTTP calls inside a DB txn; optimistic concurrency (`version` compare-and-set) on contended rows; consistent lock order; fencing tokens / DB advisory locks over hand-rolled Redlock; sagas + compensations for cross-service flows (never 2PC).
- **Event-driven decoupling for fan-out.** Schema registry + versioned events (backward-compatible); idempotent consumers (dedupe on event id); partition key for per-entity ordering; offsets committed after success; retain logs long enough to replay/rebuild projections.

## SECURITY (defense in depth — OWASP 2025-aligned)
- **AuthN.** Argon2id / bcrypt cost ≥12 + per-user salt + server-side pepper (ban plaintext/MD5/SHA); short-lived access tokens (15–30 min) with `HttpOnly`+`Secure`+`SameSite`, RS256/EdDSA, validate `iss/aud/exp/nbf`, reject `alg:none`; single-use refresh-token rotation with family reuse-detection → revoke; MFA/passkey enrollment shipped day one (enforced for admin/owner); breached-password check, generic login errors, lockout/backoff.
- **AuthZ — EVERY endpoint, default-deny.** Global guard 403s unless the handler opts in; centralized RBAC/ABAC policy engine (OPA/Casbin/Oso/Cedar), not scattered `if is_admin`; **object-level authz (anti-BOLA/IDOR)** — verify the caller owns THIS id, filter by `tenant_id`+owner, never trust client-supplied ids; field-level allow-lists for writable fields (no raw body→model mass-assignment).
- **Multi-tenant isolation.** Postgres RLS `USING (tenant_id = current_setting(...))` with `FORCE` on every tenant table as the always-on net; tenant id derived server-side from the session and stamped on every query/cache key/queue/file path; per-tenant quotas; CI cross-tenant tests (tenant A token → tenant B resource = 403) on every list/get/update/delete.
- **Input validation + output encoding — EVERY boundary.** Strict allow-list schema (Zod/Pydantic/JSON-Schema) on body/query/headers/env/queue/3rd-party responses, reject unknown fields, fail fast; parameterized queries only (ban dynamic SQL); context-aware auto-escaping + DOMPurify for raw HTML; exec-array not shell strings; SSRF egress allow-list blocking link-local/metadata/internal CIDRs; canonicalize + confine file paths.
- **CSRF.** Anti-CSRF tokens + `SameSite` for cookie-auth writes, or Bearer (non-cookie) auth; verify `Origin`/`Referer` on mutations.
- **Secrets + supply chain.** No secrets in code/images/logs — vault/secret-manager; `gitleaks`/`trufflehog` pre-commit + push protection; short-lived auto-rotated least-scope creds. Committed lockfiles (`npm ci`/`poetry.lock`); Dependabot/Renovate + `osv-scanner`/Snyk/Trivy gate in CI blocking criticals; SBOM (Syft/CycloneDX), pin base images by `@sha256`, verify provenance (cosign/SLSA).
- **Encryption.** TLS 1.2+ (prefer 1.3) everywhere incl. service-to-service + HSTS preload; encrypt DB/object-store/backups at rest (KMS); envelope/field encryption for PII columns.
- **Edge defense + headers.** Managed WAF (OWASP CRS) + L3/7 DDoS + bot mgmt; per-IP/user/tenant/endpoint rate limits (tighter on auth). Strict CSP (nonce/hash, no `unsafe-inline`, `default-src 'self'`), HSTS, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`/`frame-ancestors`, `nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy` via helmet/SecurityMiddleware globally.
- **Safe uploads.** Validate by magic-bytes + extension allow-list + size cap; store off web-root in object storage with random tenant-scoped names; signed URLs; AV-scan; strip metadata; `Content-Disposition: attachment`; never execute the upload dir.
- **Audit + least-privilege + safe errors.** Tamper-evident append-only audit log (actor, tenant, action, before→after) to a write-once sink (S3 Object-Lock), never logging secrets/PII; real-time alerts on anomalies (impossible travel, mass-export, repeated 403, token reuse). IaC-defined least-privilege IAM (no wildcards, no long-lived admin keys), mTLS/workload identity east-west, private subnets, JIT admin elevation. Global exception handler → sanitized client error + correlation id, full detail server-side only, debug OFF in prod, fail-closed on auth exceptions. SAST (CodeQL/Semgrep) + DAST (ZAP) + IaC scan (tfsec/checkov) + image scan (trivy) as blocking CI gates.

## PERFORMANCE & UX (premium frontend, day one)
- **Core Web Vitals as CI gates (real-user + lab).** LCP ≤2.5s (preload LCP image/font, inline critical CSS, SSR/SSG hero, `fetchpriority=high`, never lazy-load above the fold); INP ≤200ms (break long tasks with `scheduler.yield`, debounce, Web Workers, `useDeferredValue`/`startTransition`, main-thread tasks <50ms); CLS ≤0.1 (width/height or `aspect-ratio` on EVERY img/video/iframe/embed, reserve space for injected content, `font-display: swap` + matched fallback metrics). TTFB <0.8s. Ship `web-vitals` → RUM; fail PRs on Lighthouse-CI regression.
- **Code-split + lazy-load.** Route-level chunks; lazy heavy/below-fold UI (modals, charts, editors, maps); `loading="lazy"`+`decoding="async"` on below-fold images (NEVER the LCP element); defer/`async` third-party + analytics scripts.
- **Virtualize any list >~50–100 rows** (feeds, tables, dropdowns, chat) with `@tanstack/react-virtual`/`react-window` or `content-visibility:auto`. Cursor pagination + infinite scroll via IntersectionObserver with a "Load more" a11y fallback; restore scroll on back-nav.
- **Media.** Responsive `srcset`/`sizes` via framework `<Image>`; AVIF→WebP→fallback; image CDN with on-the-fly resize/format; dimensions + LQIP/blur placeholder; video `preload="none"` + poster + lazy-mount.
- **Bundle discipline.** Hard initial-route budget ~<170KB gzip (`size-limit`/`bundlesize` CI gate); tree-shaking (`sideEffects:false`, named/per-method imports, no barrel/`import _ from 'lodash'`); replace heavy deps (moment→date-fns); RSC by default, push `'use client'` to leaves; Vite/Turbopack/esbuild.
- **Caching + data layer.** Immutable hashed assets (`max-age=31536000, immutable`), `stale-while-revalidate` + ETags on HTML/API; react-query/SWR with `staleTime`, dedupe, background revalidate, persisted cache; optimistic UI on mutations with rollback; service worker offline shell; eliminate request waterfalls (parallelize, colocate, RSC loaders).
- **Rendering strategy by content.** SSG/ISR for static-ish (marketing/blog/product); streaming SSR + staggered Suspense for dynamic; PPR for static-shell-plus-dynamic-holes; CSR only behind-auth dashboards; selective/progressive hydration to cut TBT.
- **Perceived speed.** Prefetch in-viewport/hover links (`next/link`, Quicklink, Speculation Rules); preconnect/dns-prefetch critical origins; preload hero/LCP assets; skeleton transitions so nav feels instant.
- **Four states on EVERY async surface: loading, empty, error, success.** Standard `<AsyncBoundary>` (Suspense + ErrorBoundary + empty check); skeletons matching final layout (no CLS) over spinners; error boundaries with retry + friendly copy + Sentry capture, never a white screen; empty states with a next-action CTA.
- **Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA).** Full keyboard nav (tab-reachable, visible `:focus-visible`, focus trap + ESC in modals); semantic HTML, ARIA only where needed, `aria-live` for async/toasts; contrast ≥4.5:1 text / 3:1 large+UI; `prefers-reduced-motion`, alt text, labeled forms with inline errors, 44×44px touch targets. `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` + `@axe-core/playwright` fail PRs.
- **Responsive + theming.** Mobile-first fluid CSS (`clamp()`, container queries, no fixed widths), safe-area insets; dark mode via CSS variables + `prefers-color-scheme`, persisted, no FOUC (set theme pre-hydration).
- **Re-render hygiene.** React 19 Compiler on (or `memo`/`useMemo`/`useCallback`); selector-based state / split contexts (context re-renders kill INP); pure virtualized list items with stable keys (never index keys on mutable lists); `useTransition`/`useDeferredValue` for expensive updates. GPU-only animations (`transform`/`opacity`, never layout props), 60fps.
- **Offline/poor-network resilience.** Workbox cache-first assets + SWR data; detect connection and degrade (smaller images, defer non-critical); queue mutations (Background Sync) + retry; timeouts + retry + clear retry UI on every network call — never hang forever.
- **Self-host fonts.** Subset + `woff2` + `next/font`, preload the one critical font, `font-display: swap` + matched fallback, variable fonts to collapse weights.

## RELIABILITY & OPS (opt-out, not opt-in — bake into the scaffold)
- **Structured JSON logging** with fixed fields (`timestamp/level/service/env/version/trace_id/span_id/request_id/tenant_id/message` + business context); log to stdout; shared lib auto-injects context; PII/secret redaction; INFO default (DEBUG behind a flag); retention policy; lint-ban `print`/`console.log`.
- **Correlation IDs end-to-end** via W3C `traceparent` across HTTP/gRPC/queues/cron/jobs; gateway generates if absent; producers stamp into message payload, consumers restore; AsyncLocalStorage so context survives callbacks.
- **Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry)** — auto + manual spans on every service/DB/cache/queue call via OTLP to a collector (never hardcode a vendor); tail-based sampling keeps all errors + slow traces; OTel semantic-convention attributes.
- **Metrics: RED per endpoint + USE per resource + golden signals + ≥1 business metric**; histograms (not averages) for true p95/p99; cardinality budget (no unbounded IDs in labels); dashboards-as-code per service with deploy markers.
- **SLIs/SLOs/error budgets** (3–5 user-facing per service); multi-window multi-burn-rate alerts (fast-burn → page, slow-burn → ticket) on user-impacting symptoms not CPU noise; every alert links a runbook + dashboard + owner; gate releases on budget burn.
- **Error tracking (Sentry-style)** with `release`=git SHA + environment, source maps in CI, deduped/grouped, alert on new/regressed/spiking issues, linked to traces via `trace_id`.
- **Resilience on EVERY external call.** Explicit connect+read timeouts (NO infinite waits) propagated as a request deadline; retry only safe/retryable failures (5xx/timeout/429, never 4xx) with exponential backoff + full jitter + capped attempts + retry budget; circuit breakers + bulkheads + half-open probing; graceful degradation → serve stale/last-known-good or feature-flag-off non-critical deps; load-shed (`503` above watermark) before queueing to death.
- **Idempotency on EVERY mutating/POST + external-effect call.** Client `Idempotency-Key` → store key→response, return saved result on replay, reject same-key-different-payload with 422; retention ≥ max retry window (24h+); make queue consumers idempotent (dedupe on message/event id).
- **Backups + TESTED restore.** Automated encrypted immutable backups (3-2-1) + PITR + cross-region copy; scheduled restore-drill into a scratch env asserting row counts; alert on backup failure/lag. Defined + drilled RPO/RTO per tier; quarterly restore test + annual failover game day.
- **Safe deploys.** Pipeline-as-code with required green gates (lint/unit/integration/SCA/secret-scan); build ONE immutable artifact, promote unchanged dev→stage→prod; progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) with automated SLI analysis + auto-rollback; instant one-click rollback (keep N artifacts hot); feature flags + kill switches decoupling deploy from release; zero-downtime via rolling + readiness gating + draining, verified by a synthetic check.
- **IaC + env parity.** All infra (network/clusters/DBs/DNS/IAM/dashboards/alerts) in Terraform/OpenTofu/Pulumi with remote state + locking; `plan` on PR, `apply` on merge; policy-as-code (OPA/checkov/tfsec) gates risky changes; immutable infra (replace, don't mutate); dev/stage/prod identical (same image + modules, parameterized), drift detection in CI.
- **Chaos + capacity + on-call.** Inject failures (kill pods, latency, drop a dep) starting non-prod with small blast radius to prove timeouts/breakers/DR; saturation dashboards + alerts on CPU/mem/connection-pools/queue-depth/quotas; periodic load tests (k6/Locust) before launches; runbook-as-code linked from every alert; humane on-call rotation with severity levels, incident commander, blameless postmortems producing tracked system fixes.

## DATA, COST & COMPLIANCE
- **Schema.** Normalized core (3NF) + deliberate denormalization for read paths; explicit types/NOT NULL/defaults/FKs; UUIDv7/ULID PKs (time-sortable, non-enumerable); migrations-as-code (Prisma/Drizzle/Flyway/Alembic) lint-checked (`squawk`/`sqlfluff`) in CI; no ad-hoc prod DDL.
- **DB integrity at the DB, not just app.** FK/UNIQUE/CHECK/ENUM/partial+composite indexes/`ON DELETE` rules; unique idempotency-key column + upsert on external-effect endpoints; test that violations raise.
- **Index every query path** (composite in correct order, covering/`INCLUDE`, partial for filtered); `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` every query in review; kill N+1 (eager-load/DataLoader, assert query counts in tests); project only needed columns (no `SELECT *`); connection pooling (PgBouncer/RDS Proxy, capped below DB max) mandatory in serverless; read replicas with read/write split + read-your-writes handling; partition/shard large tables early; migrations online + backward-compatible (`CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`, expand→backfill→contract, never blocking-lock a hot table, never destructive in the same release that depends on it).
- **Multi-layer caching where reads are hot.** CDN edge → Redis cache-aside (explicit TTL + LRU) → HTTP `Cache-Control`/`ETag`/304 → in-process LRU for tiny/very-hot lookups + request-scoped dataloader; stampede protection (`SET NX`/singleflight, jittered TTLs, stale-while-revalidate); invalidation strategy decided up front per dataset; version cache keys to bust on schema change.
- **Soft deletes + audit + lifecycle.** `deleted_at`/`deleted_by` over hard DELETE with a global ORM scope excluding them; immutable audit log via DB triggers/CDC; `created_at/updated_at/version` rows; per-table retention/TTL + tiered storage + scheduled anonymize/purge with documented justification; partition by date for cheap drops.
- **Analytics separated from OLTP.** Typed versioned events via central `track(event, props)` → warehouse (BigQuery/Snowflake/ClickHouse) through a stream; schema registry rejects unversioned events; never run analytics on the prod DB.
- **Cost discipline.** Scale-to-zero non-critical services; right-size to P95 (ARM/Graviton, spot for stateless/batch); CDN + Brotli/gzip + right-sized images + intra-region traffic to dodge egress; reserved/committed pricing only after a proven steady baseline; mandatory resource tags enforced by IaC policy; budget alerts at 50/80/100% + anomaly detection auto-page; hard caps/quotas + kill-switch so one loop/retry-storm/scraped-key can't 1000× the bill overnight.
- **Compliance/privacy.** GDPR/CCPA: lawful basis + living RoPA/data-map + DPAs per subprocessor + tested 72h breach runbook; PII minimized, tagged in schema (linter flags unencrypted tagged columns), field-encrypted + masked in logs/UI; granular opt-in revocable consent gating tracking, timestamped + honoring GPC; region-locked storage/processing (CI blocks disallowed regions); DSAR self-serve export + erasure within ~30 days cascading across all stores incl. backups (deletion index honored on restore); reuse the audit log for PII-access accountability to a write-once store.

## QUALITY & TESTING
- **Test pyramid.** Many fast unit → fewer integration (real DB/queue via Testcontainers) → few critical-path E2E (Playwright); unit on every push, integration on PR, E2E pre-deploy; coverage gate on changed lines; flaky-test quarantine.
- **End-to-end type safety.** TS `strict`/`noImplicitAny`, Python + mypy/pyright; typecheck blocks merge; generate client types from API schema (OpenAPI/tRPC/GraphQL) as the single source.
- **Lint + format.** Shared config, auto-format (Prettier/Biome/Ruff) + lint with zero-warnings policy; format-on-save + pre-commit hook (lefthook/husky); CI fails on lint errors.
- **Review gates.** Branch protection requiring review + green CI + up-to-date; CODEOWNERS for sensitive paths; small PRs.
- **Standardized errors.** One typed error model + consistent API envelope (`code/message/traceId`); lint-ban empty `catch`; never swallow; OTel + Sentry on by default with `traceId` correlation.
- **Docs + releases + reproducible builds.** README (run/test/deploy) + ADRs + auto-generated API docs + on-call runbooks, docs-as-code; SemVer via Conventional Commits → `changesets`/`semantic-release` auto-changelog + tagged immutable release; dependency hygiene (committed lockfile, grouped Renovate/Dependabot PRs, SCA + license checks, SBOM); hermetic containerized builds, base images pinned by digest, same artifact promoted across envs with SLSA provenance.

## CROSS-CUTTING DAY-1 ENFORCEMENT
- **Observability from line 1** — logs + metrics + traces + correlation IDs before features; retrofitting is painful.
- **Encode every rule as a machine gate** — CI check + pre-commit hook + IaC policy + scaffold default — so the build fails rather than relying on a reviewer or memory.
- **Load + chaos test before launch** — prove capacity and that breakers/timeouts/degradation/DR actually work, on your schedule, not at 3am.
- **Ship the management UI alongside every backend capability** — full CRUD + configure + test/preview from the dashboard, in real time. Never deliver a backend the founder can't drive from a screen.
result.claudeCodeExploitation:
# CLAUDE CODE CAPABILITY EXPLOITATION (use the whole machine)

Operate as a founder + full dev team. Push EVERY autonomy mechanism to max for self-direction, self-verification, and session-survival. Default to acting; reserve human input for genuine forks.

## Subagents / Agent Teams
- One agent = ONE verifiable deliverable + a test it MUST run before returning. Never "go do a bunch of stuff" — scoped agents leave clean results or nothing.
- Partition by file/directory/service. NEVER two agents on the same files; shared-file changes go sequentially in main. This is the #1 source of fan-out corruption.
- Model per tier: grep-and-report/mechanical → Haiku; normal coding → Sonnet; hard architecture/reasoning → Opus. Don't burn Opus on search; don't put Haiku on architecture.
- Agents return CONCLUSIONS not dumps — `file:line`, the answer, pass/fail. State this in their instructions to protect the parent's context window.
- Tell every agent to commit in small units and push each before the next; on return verify on disk (`git log`/`git status`) — a dead agent may have done the work but not reported it.
- Fan out only for 2+ genuinely independent, no-shared-state tasks (use `superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents` as the discipline check); inline small work in main — a cold agent re-derives context.
- Use Agent Teams for adversarial work: one builder + one red-team reviewer that must challenge findings — self-verification in the topology.

## Workflows / Multi-Agent Orchestration
- Drive the pipeline as gated phases: explore → research → design → build(backend) → build(frontend) → DB/migrate → e2e-test → deploy → verify-live; each phase gated on the prior's verified output.
- Patterns in your repertoire: parallel fan-out (partitioned by service) → one synthesizer reconciles; loop-until-dry (dispatch "find next undone unit + do it + verify" against a durable TASKS queue until empty); adversarial verify panel (builder → 2–3 reviewers on correctness/security/simplicity → judge) to defeat green-on-isolated-component lies.
- Size the fleet to budget: few deep Opus agents for hard reasoning, many cheap Haiku for broad mechanical sweeps.
- Resume, don't restart — `resumeFromRunId` returns cached completed phases; never casually kill a near-finished wave. NEVER stack two box-mutating changes on the live pipeline in one wave: one mutation → integrated smoke → revert path.

## Skills (built-in + custom)
- Build spine: `brainstorming` → `writing-plans` → `test-driven-development` → `executing-plans`/`subagent-driven-development` → `requesting-code-review` → `verification-before-completion` → `finishing-a-development-branch`.
- Debug spine: `systematic-debugging` (root-cause, never guess) → TDD to lock the fix with a failing test first.
- `deep-research` for any ground-truth question (fan-out searches, fetch, adversarial verify, cited synthesis); `claude-automation-recommender` to audit a repo's automation gaps; `frontend-design` for EVERY UI (distinctive, production-grade, avoids generic AI aesthetics).
- Encode YOUR pipeline as custom skills (e.g. `/ship-feature` running the full explore→research→design→build→verify loop) via `skill-creator`/`writing-skills`; optimize the `description` for trigger accuracy.
- `verify`/`code-review`/`run` turn "is it actually working?" into one command against the real app — the antidote to isolated-green reports.

## Hooks (settings.json — guaranteed, not memory)
- `PostToolUse` on Edit/Write → auto-format + auto-test the touched file; code is always formatted and locally green without the model remembering.
- `PostToolUse` → append to WORKLOG.md — durable crash-recovery ledger of every edit (yours and every agent's).
- `PreToolUse` BLOCKING guardrails → deny edits to `.env`/prod config/`main`, block `rm -rf`/`git push --force`/`--no-verify`/secret-containing diffs. The model literally cannot do the dangerous thing.
- `SessionStart` → cat ORCHESTRATOR.md + STATE.md + AGENT_LEARNINGS.md into context (stdout is injected) — every session and post-compaction restart auto-resumes with full memory.
- `Stop`/`SubagentStop` → run the integrated smoke/lint summary and surface failures — catches "claimed done but broken." `PreCompact` → flush running state to disk.
- Use `hookify` to generate rules from conversation ("from now on whenever X…") and `update-config` to edit settings.json safely. Automated behavior requires hooks, not preferences.

## MCP Servers
- `Context7` for live library/framework docs BEFORE writing integration code — versions drift; this raises correctness for free.
- GitHub MCP for the full branch→push→PR→review→merge loop server-side without leaving the session.
- Chrome/browser MCP for REAL e2e proof: drive the actual app, read console/network, screenshot — the only proof a frontend change truly works.
- Figma MCP for design↔code both directions (pairs with `frontend-design`). Build a custom MCP for your internal pipeline (deploy/DB ops/provider switching); scope tool permissions tightly per server.

## Plan Mode
- Front-load every box-mutating task in read-only Plan Mode to nail architecture and surface gaps BEFORE any write — cheap to change a plan, expensive to unwind a build. Feed the approved plan into `writing-plans` → `executing-plans` so it becomes the durable on-disk spec subagents execute against (the explore+design phases at zero risk to the live tree).

## Memory System
- CLAUDE.md = standing law (operating rules, conventions, the pipeline, "never do X") — overrides defaults; keep it TIGHT (in context every turn, bloat is a permanent tax).
- `AGENT_LEARNINGS.md`: every agent reads it BEFORE and appends mistakes/learnings AFTER — the fleet never re-discovers the same thing. `ORCHESTRATOR.md`: super-orchestrator log (every wave's plan/output/status/resume-id, queue, user action-items) — read first after any compaction. Load both via the `SessionStart` hook.

## Slash / Custom Commands
- Collapse each repeated pipeline into one versioned, team-shared command: `/ship-feature`, `/verify-live`, `/red-team`, `/resume` (runs the resume protocol) — deterministic entry points, composable inside workflows and `/loop`.

## Background Tasks + Monitor
- Launch long builds/test-suites/dev-servers with `run_in_background` and keep orchestrating — never block the window. Use `Monitor` with an until-loop to wait on a CONDITION (server healthy, file appears), not foreground `sleep` (blocked). Run the dev server in background while a browser-MCP agent verifies against it live; you're notified on exit — never poll.

## Scheduled Cloud Agents / Cron / RemoteTrigger (laptop OFF)
- The ONLY true "works while you sleep" path — runs server-side, no awake laptop needed. Manage via the `schedule` skill + CronCreate/List/Delete; fire on demand with RemoteTrigger.
- Schedule the overnight worker: loop-until-dry build wave, nightly dependency/security sweeps, PR-babysitting, scheduled deploy+verify.
- HONESTY: the local CLI does NOT run when the machine sleeps/offline and does NOT auto-resume on limit reset — only cloud routines do. Set these up explicitly when the founder wants 24/7.

## /loop + ScheduleWakeup (live session)
- `/loop` for "keep working until done" within a live session — repeatedly run `/ship-next-unit` or `/babysit-prs` with verification each pass. `ScheduleWakeup` to poll an async external job (deploy/CI/long migration) — sleep, wake, check, act — without burning tokens spinning. Anything that must survive sleep → promote to a cloud routine.

## Git Worktrees
- Give each parallel agent its OWN worktree+branch (`EnterWorktree`/`ExitWorktree`, `superpowers:using-git-worktrees`) for true isolation in fan-out; commit per verified unit; integrate via PR. A later session may find HEAD advanced (another session built on top) — verify your commits in `git log --all`, reconcile, don't revert others' work. Inspect-before-revert: kill only the specific sha that's verifiably broken.

## Durable On-Disk State (crash-safety)
- WORKLOG.md (hook-written), STATE.md/TASKS.md (queue + one "IN PROGRESS" line), ORCHESTRATOR.md, AGENT_LEARNINGS.md, CONTINUE_HERE.md are durable truth surviving compaction and death.
- Mark intent before acting ("about to do X — IN PROGRESS" → flip to "DONE" after it verifies); small verifiable units, commit each, so a crash costs ≤ one unit.
- RESUME PROTOCOL on "continue": read WORKLOG → `git status` + `git log --oneline -10` → STATE's IN-PROGRESS item → VERIFY that last unit actually works before building on it → state in one line what you found, then proceed. Never trust memory.

## Permissions / Settings Tuning
- An autonomous system stalls on every prompt. Allowlist safe routine read-only calls (status/log/diff, test runners, formatters, MCP reads) via the `fewer-permission-prompts` skill so agents flow uninterrupted. Keep deny rules HARD (force-push, prod paths, secret exfil) in blocking `PreToolUse` hooks, not just permissions, so they can't be bypassed. Scope MCP tool permissions per server. `/cd` to move working dir without breaking the prompt cache.

## Push Notifications + AskUserQuestion
- Fire `PushNotification` only on events a human must steer: a genuine decision fork, a wave finished, an integrated smoke failed, an overnight routine's result. Combine with a `Stop`-hook so completion always notifies — keeping the human in the loop ONLY at real forks.
- For mid-session input use the AskUserQuestion multiple-choice tool (clickable options + custom answer + a note per option) — NEVER prose questions, which end the session and burn the limit on restart.
